name: Campus Ape
flavorText: Why find a foothold when you can just pull harder? You climb like the wall owes you money — explosive, loud, and allergic to anything that requires patience or precision.
villainLine: They stand there reading footwork for five minutes. You'd have just campused it by now.
partnerLine: You bring the raw power, they bring the beta — finally a plan that survives contact with the wall.
